pairs.subject: native-shell-integration
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/_shell/keys.ts:1 The shell is an in-document Next.js chrome whose only persistent capability is browser localStorage; a search of the shell directory, the root and package manifests for tauri/electron/capacitor/ipcRenderer/webview found no native wrapper process, so the subject's precondition (a native process holding capabilities the presentation layer cannot reach) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/_shell/keys.ts:20 keys.ts registers storage keys, not hardware key codes; no wrapper forwards remote/controller keys
